newTbl <- select(rawTbl, f_article['name'], f_article['id'], ts, f_metric['description'])

Bump? Anyone?

Thanks

messages.author: b756a7daa2c2aa6d
messages.subject: Re: How to transform JSON object columns in tbl to tbl with single values from json
parts:
It's hard to give you a precise answer without reproducible code, but
probably something like:

rawTbl %>%
collect() %>%
mutate_all(jsonlite::fromJSON)

Then use purrr and techniques from https://jennybc.github.io/purrr-tutorial/

Hadley
